professional.title: Professional Wheel Building Service
professional.body: We provide professional assembly services, supporting customers who wish to send in hubs or rims. Our skilled technicians will complete the assembly to the highest standards.
professional.feeBody: USD 30 / set for standard wheel building service.
professional.bestForBody: Customers sending compatible hubs, rims, or full component kits for professional assembly.
professional.button: Get Wheel Building Quote via Chat

shipping.title: Shipping

confirmation.title: Confirmation
confirmation.body: We inspect and confirm receipt of all listed items.

assembly.title: Assembly & testing
assembly.body: Professional build plus tension and safety analysis.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.body: Finished wheelset shipped back or prepared for pickup.

scope.title: Scope & Notes
scope.acceptedBody: Wheelsets, rims, hubs, spokes, or related components. Please confirm compatibility with us first.
items: Components must be new or in good condition.
Shipping costs are the customer's responsibility.

ownBuild.title: Building Your Own Wheels?
ownBuild.body: If you prefer to assemble yourself using these parts, we support you. Access our technical guides and customization options below.
